description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for osquery result/status logs relayed as one JSON object per line, with fixture-backed result/status, endpoint activity, hardware device, user/session/scheduled-task, SSH authorized-key, SUID binary, and startup-item families.

normalized_fields.osquery_log_type: Derived result, snapshot, or status family
normalized_fields.hostIdentifier: osquery host identifier preserved from the source log
normalized_fields.action: osquery result action such as added, removed, or snapshot; status logs derive action=status
normalized_fields.severity: osquery status severity token where present
normalized_fields.signature: Query name for results or filename for status logs
normalized_fields.signature_id: Counter/line context used only as local triage aid
normalized_fields.port: columns.port or columns.local_port for listening-port rows
normalized_fields.protocol: columns.protocol or columns.type normalized to uppercase where present
normalized_fields.file_path: columns.path or columns.target_path for process/file activity rows
normalized_fields.cmdline: columns.cmdline for process execution rows; preserved by default because it is analyst-critical and may be sensitive/noisy
normalized_fields.uid: columns.uid for process/file ownership or execution context
normalized_fields.hardware_action: columns.action from hardware_events rows; distinct from top-level osquery result action
normalized_fields.hardware_path: columns.path local device path assigned by osquery hardware_events when present
normalized_fields.hardware_type: columns.type hardware/device event type from osquery hardware_events
normalized_fields.hardware_driver: columns.driver driver stating the hardware device when present
normalized_fields.hardware_vendor: columns.vendor hardware device vendor string from osquery hardware_events
normalized_fields.hardware_vendor_id: columns.vendor_id hex-encoded hardware vendor identifier from osquery hardware_events
normalized_fields.hardware_model: columns.model hardware device model string from osquery hardware_events
normalized_fields.hardware_model_id: columns.model_id hex-encoded hardware model identifier from osquery hardware_events
normalized_fields.hardware_serial: columns.serial device serial from osquery hardware_events fixture; sensitive and retained by default for audit correlation
normalized_fields.hardware_revision: columns.revision device revision from osquery hardware_events
normalized_fields.user_name: columns.username or columns.user for account/session rows
normalized_fields.user_shell: columns.shell for local account inventory rows
normalized_fields.user_home: columns.directory for local account home directory context
normalized_fields.session_tty: columns.tty for logged-in user session rows
normalized_fields.session_host: columns.host for logged-in user remote host context
normalized_fields.session_time: columns.time source timestamp for logged-in user session rows
normalized_fields.cron_command: columns.command for crontab scheduled task rows; retained by default because it is analyst-critical and may be sensitive/noisy
normalized_fields.cron_path: columns.path for crontab source file path when present
normalized_fields.cron_schedule: derived minute/hour/day/month/day-of-week schedule string from crontab columns
normalized_fields.ssh_key_algorithm: columns.algorithm for authorized_keys rows; key material itself is not surfaced as a normalized field
normalized_fields.ssh_key_comment: columns.comment for authorized_keys rows; sensitive in production and retained only as audit context
normalized_fields.ssh_key_options: columns.options for authorized_keys rows when present
normalized_fields.startup_args: columns.args for startup_items rows; may include sensitive command arguments and is retained by default

pack_variants.label: osquery result/status JSON relay
pack_variants.description: osquery result and status JSON records preserving query name, host identifier, result action, status severity/message, and query-dependent columns.
known_limitations: No live osquery relay replay/read-back captured.
Only one-line JSON result/status logs are fixture-backed; batched results, local logger options, and collector wrapping need local validation.
Query-dependent columns are represented by selected process/listening-port examples only and do not state full osquery schema coverage.
Evented table fixtures are limited to process_events, file_events, and socket_events schemas from public osquery table specs; local auditing/event-publisher configuration still needs validation.
Hardware events are represented from the public upstream hardware_events table spec only; local UDEV/IOKit event publisher behavior and hardware telemetry completeness need validation.
User/account, logged-in session, and crontab scheduled-task rows are schema-grounded but not live endpoint validated.
SSH authorized key, SUID binary, and startup item fixtures are schema-grounded only; local query scheduling, OS support, privacy review, and key-material handling need validation.

cribl.notes: Use only after sampling the local osquery feed. Do not drop hostIdentifier, name, calendarTime, unixTime, action, severity, message, columns, or raw JSON by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

Selected result/status and evented-table JSON shapes are covered; query-dependent columns, batched result lines, local logger/event-publisher options, buffering/replay behavior, and collector envelopes remain future coverage.
Hardware_events fixtures are synthetic-equivalent and schema-grounded only; local UDEV/IOKit publisher behavior, serial handling, and collector envelopes remain future coverage.
